controls.verification_method: In-kernel eBPF probe on sys_enter_connect rejecting all non-loopback IP packets (EPERM).

controls.cryptographic_mechanism: In-process memory encryption using AES-256-GCM / Ephemeral Ed25519 IPC signing.
